description: The file defines the 'TestCluster' class, which provides mechanisms to deploy, manage, and control an Orleans test environment for local testing with in-process silos. It includes functionalities for starting/stopping silos, initializing clients, handling cluster configurations, and logging.

classes.name: TestCluster
classes.description: A class for deploying and managing a local Orleans test environment with in-process silos. Supports operations like starting, stopping, restarting silos, and initializing clients for unit testing.

methods.name: Deploy
methods.description: Synchronously deploys the test cluster with initial silos and optional client deployment.

methods.name: DeployAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deploys the test cluster with initial silos and optional client initialization.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns an enumerable of currently active silos within the cluster.

methods.name: GetSiloForAddress
methods.description: Finds and returns the silo handle corresponding to a specific SiloAddress.

methods.name: WaitForLivenessToStabilizeAsync
methods.description: Waits for the cluster to reach a stable membership state after changes.

methods.name: StartAdditionalSilo
methods.description: Starts a new additional silo to join the existing cluster.

methods.name: StopClusterClientAsync
methods.description: Stops the internal cluster client connection.

methods.name: StopAllSilos
methods.description: Synchronously stops all silos and client.

methods.name: StopAllSilosAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops all silos and client.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops an individual silo, optionally gracefully.

methods.name: KillSiloAsync
methods.description: Immediately kills a silo to simulate a crash.

methods.name: RestartStoppedSecondarySiloAsync
methods.description: Restarts a previously stopped secondary silo.

methods.name: InitializeClientAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Orleans cluster client based on current configurations.
